text: The future of AI is exciting and uncertain. Today we have "narrow AI," which is good at one task, like translating languages. Experts are now working on "artificial general intelligence" (AGI), a machine that could think like a human. AGI could bring great benefits, such as solving problems in medicine and science. However, it also carries risks, like job losses or safety problems. Predictions about when AGI will arrive vary widely. Some experts believe it could happen in the next ten to twenty years, while others think it is much further away. Nobody knows for sure, but one thing is clear: AI will change our lives.
